description:
Replace the issue record path spellings in commands and validation with the `VirtualPath` issue-record constructor.

## Background

Production `issues/{..}.json` spellings remain in `commands/mod.rs` (6), `commands/gate_check.rs` (6), `commands/document.rs` (3), `commands/template.rs` (3), `commands/gate.rs` (2), `commands/snapshot.rs` (2), `commands/validate.rs` (2), `commands/batch_create.rs` (1), `commands/claim.rs` (1) and `validation/repository.rs` (1). Record file names are spelled as `format!("{id}.json")` at `commands/gate.rs:368`, `commands/template.rs:655` and `validation/repository.rs:399`. `VirtualPath::issue_record(&IssueId)` (`repository_state/path.rs`) is the one constructor.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No production `format!` under `crates/jit/src/commands/` or `crates/jit/src/validation/` spells an issue record path or record file name.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each such site derives the path, or the file name, from `VirtualPath::issue_record`.
title: Commands take issue record paths from the VirtualPath constructor
